No, we can't certify that no fire occurred. We can only say that NASA FIRMS detected no thermal anomalies on the asset.

**What the evidence shows:** Between 2026-10-06 and 2026-11-05, zero FIRMS thermal detections intersected the asset boundary. All four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered every day of the period.

**Why it isn't certification:** Satellite thermal detection can miss small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires. The evidence also doesn't tell us about burned area, the cause of any change on the ground (harvest, fire, storm, clearing), or anything outside this period.

**Suggested wording:** "No satellite thermal detections were recorded on the asset during the period, with full sensor coverage."

If you need stronger assurance, you could add burned-area analysis or optical imagery review, or obtain ground confirmation.
